{"id":"3f49b09b-4825-4f88-8802-f2b2ea3b0b58","object":"chat.completion","created":1790167018,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"","reasoning_content":"The failing spec is retry_safe. I'll do that.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_pm2E3PUY4Qjr5xvGfWRg8631","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reserved: true }));\n    const notified = call(\"notify\", {});\n    return Response.json({ notified: notified.status }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":30489,"completion_tokens":1728,"total_tokens":32217,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":23808},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":1454},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":23808,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":6681},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
